record.title: Acquire one stopped stock RAW diagnostic and restore the bench
record.intent: Observe actual samples at adequate display range without claiming a comparative RF result.
requirements: Execute only the independently accepted fresh diagnostic under renewed operator continuation and original hard deadline2026-10-03T01:38:03Z. Check positive ownership and absence of duplicate helpers before launch.

Preserve one source attempt and one RAW record or explicit abort, request/response bytes, capture and settings/epoch metadata. No retries, additional points, hidden guard changes, native transition or physical wiring action.

Restore exact ordinary/export and host isolation, retire owned helpers with graceful recorder/drop statistics, seal actual evidence separately and obtain independent review. Commit and push the conclusion before any successor experiment.
acceptance: One completed or explicitly aborted diagnostic has immutable evidence and recorded final state.
